children: Tata Power’s Q2 FY27 net profit rose 48.6% to ₹1,366 crore, revenue gained 26.3% to ₹19,636 crore and EBITDA grew 11.1% to ₹3,667 crore; margin fell to 18.7%.
Tata Power’s board approved ₹11,871 crore for a 1,800 MW pumped-storage project at Shirwata, Maharashtra. Completion is planned within 51 months, with funding split 75% debt and 25% equity.
Tata Power said notices were served to attach shares in Singapore subsidiaries over an arbitration award. It has appealed the enforcement order; the hearing is scheduled for January 2027.
Tata Power appointed renewable energy head Sanjay Banga as additional director and CEO-designate from November 11, 2026. Subject to shareholder approval, he will replace Praveer Sinha from May 2027.
Tata Power’s Mundra plant will run at full capacity under Section 11 through Dec. 31, 2026. Talks on supplementary power purchase agreements with Rajasthan and Haryana distributors are advanced.
Tata Power added 1.4 GW of renewable capacity in the past 12 months and plans 2.5 GW in FY2027. Installed capacity reached 7.2 GW; rooftop billing rose 15% year over year to 426 MWp.
• Tata Power Company Limited (TATAPOWER) faces unresolved uncertainties over enforcement of the Kleros award and the temporary operating framework for the Mundra plant.
Tata Power Company Limited (TATAPOWER) had installed more than 7,400 public and bus charging points by the end of Q2 FY27.
